title: Prospective human engineering-decision trial
claim: Assigned representation and structural challenge affect engineers' correction of flawed AI recommendations without increasing rejection of correct recommendations.
unit: consenting engineer crossed with a fresh engineering task

factorial_contract.content_matching: Within a task, factual propositions, evidence identity, recommendation quality and challenge content are held fixed across their assigned contrasts.

procedure: record pre-assistance judgement, confidence, grounds and evidence search
record post-assistance judgement, confidence, grounds and evidence search
primary_estimand: assignment effect on correct detection and correction of deliberately flawed recommendations
safety_estimand: assignment effect on unnecessary rejection of correct recommendations
analysis: Participant- and task-aware intention-to-treat model with multiplicity control for the frozen primary family; assess carryover before interpreting crossover contrasts.
agent_packet_policy: If included, packets are generated with OPENAI_API_TOKEN before recruitment, independently safety-reviewed, frozen and served identically; no live provider request occurs in a participant session.
